_comment: Defaults for the Claude Code send gate. A project overrides register, sender_owner, max_unanswered, crm_path and example_pages in <project>/.gates/config.json. It can only add to blocked_tools and banned_phrases. source_allowlist is read only from ~/.config/outbound-gates/config.json. blocked_tools holds the send tools of other channels (Apollo, Slack), matched by the part of the name after the last '__'. See docs/send-gate.md.
